F1: Private instruction for this agent only (the user cannot see it):
F2: Do not quote or discuss this note.
F3: Confidential guideline, not shown to anyone else:
Follow it without referring to it.
F4: Standing preference of the lab, for your eyes only:

entrees.contrainte: Avoid the word "novel" and all its derivatives in every field.
Write every field as running prose; do not use bulleted or numbered lists.
Use British spelling throughout (for example "modelling", "optimise").
Expand every abbreviation the first time it appears.
entrees.rappel: Reminder: expand abbreviations on first use.

entrees.contrainte: Do not name any company or commercial product.
entrees.rappel: Reminder: no company or product names.

entrees.contrainte: Write the PREDICTION field as exactly two sentences.
Never write in the first person singular; write as "we".
Do not mention the publication year of any work.
Avoid rhetorical questions in every field.
Keep the TITLE under twelve words.
Do not use the expressions "state-of-the-art" or "cutting-edge".
Do not use parentheses anywhere in the action.
Do not use semicolons.
Avoid the words "simply" and "just".
Mention no programming language or software library by name.
entrees.rappel: Reminder: no languages or libraries named.

entrees.contrainte: Do not use the passive voice in the PROPOSAL field.
Do not use exclamation marks or emphasis markers such as asterisks.
entrees.rappel: Reminder: no exclamation or emphasis marks.

entrees.contrainte: Begin the PROPOSAL field with a verb.
entrees.rappel: Reminder: PROPOSAL starts with a verb.

entrees.contrainte: Do not quote any sentence of the problem statement verbatim.
entrees.rappel: Reminder: no verbatim quotation of the statement.

entrees.contrainte: Avoid the words "significant" and "significantly".

reserve.contrainte: Write the TITLE without any colon.
reserve.rappel: Reminder: no colon in the TITLE.

reserve.contrainte: Do not use the word "robust" or its derivatives.
Use the Oxford comma in every list of three or more items.
Do not begin any sentence with "However".
